atr_stop_analysis.finding: Replacing M1 `(100-X)*scale` with 2.0x ATR(14) reduced stop-out frequency from 50.0% to 39.3%.

regime_filter_analysis.finding: 6-state regime filter added +6.89 pp return while reducing MaxDD by +1.15 pp.

trade_count_and_funnel.finding: M2.0/M2.1 take fewer trades because signals require both causal technical alignment AND favorable Nifty regime + liquidity/risk-budget headroom.

eref_leakage_audit.finding: E-Ref (-14.11%) differs from Clean Causal M2.1 (-10.54%). Pearson r=+0.162 between today's fundamental score and prior 4Y stock returns proves retrospective winner leakage contaminates static-ratio backtests.

component_attribution.component: ATR(14) Stop-Loss Normalization vs M1 Formula
component_attribution.evidence: Cut SL hit rate from 50.0% (M1 fundamental compression) to 39.3% (M2.1), preventing stop-outs inside normal daily noise.
Blocking WEAK_BEARISH, STRONG_BEARISH & HIGH_VOLATILITY shifted total return by +6.89 pp and reduced MaxDD by +1.15 pp vs permissive M2.1 control.

component_attribution.component: Clean Causal Trend + Portfolio Correlation/Concentration Limits
component_attribution.evidence: M2.1 Sharpe -1.24 / MaxDD 21.03% vs M2.0 Sharpe -0.9 / MaxDD 27.84% with max sector cap (35.48%) and liquidity/gap safeguards.

component_attribution.component: Static Current Fundamentals (E-Ref vs Clean Causal)
component_attribution.evidence: Today's Fund Scores show Pearson r=+0.162 correlation with 2021–2025 stock performance — past winners end up with high trailing ROE/Growth/MCap scores today (r=+0.162), shifting E-Ref (-14.11%) away from Causal M2.1 (-10.54%) due to retrospective winner knowledge rather than causal predictability.

component_attribution.component: Selectivity & Rejection Funnel (Accepted vs Counterfactual Rejected)
component_attribution.evidence: Accepted trades (466, mean -0.386%, win 42.27%) vs Rejected opportunities (13383 counterfactuals, mean -0.025%, win 44.92%).

final_decision.classification: 1. Research failure: No reliable edge demonstrated
final_decision.rationale: Over 466 realistic Indian delivery trades across 5 years, Moreshwar 2.1 generated -10.54% total (-2.22% CAGR, Sharpe -1.24, p=0.1084), failing to deliver a statistically reliable positive net edge over transaction costs, Cash (6.5%), or Nifty 50 (+48.78%).
unresolved_risks: Lack of historical quarterly point-in-time Indian fundamental financial statements (only OHLCV is cleanly non-leaked over 5 years).
Purged delisted companies (DHFL, RELCAPITAL, SINTEX) return 404 on free Yahoo endpoints, leaving partial survivorship bias despite distressed controls (YESBANK, JETAIRWAYS, RCOM, ZEEL).
Trend-following equity swing entries earn modest capital utilization during bearish/sideways regimes, trailing 6.5% risk-free Indian T-bills in prolonged choppy markets.
